name: CompositionBar — election seats (Phase 3.6)
description: A/B experiment shipping the new single-entity 100%-stacked CompositionBar primitive on the state-hub elections card. Treatment shows CompositionBar alongside the existing SeatDonut; control sees SeatDonut alone (existing behaviour). URL stays canonical (place-first per ADR-0028); bucket is sticky via a first-party cookie keyed on a stable visitor id. Phase 3.6 of TODO/20260518-frontend-charting-modernisation-plan.md.

variations.name: Control — SeatDonut only (current production)
variations.description: Existing state-overview render: <SeatDonut /> as the sole composition chart. No new component mounted.

variations.name: Treatment — CompositionBar alongside SeatDonut
variations.description: Render <CompositionBar model={...} sources={...} /> immediately after <SeatDonut /> in the elections card. Both charts visible at once, same data binding, no URL toggle.

rules.description: Per plan resolution R-02 — mount only on single-party-dominant state-hub routes. TN is excluded because the verdict is alliance-led and a party-only chart misframes it.

primary.description: Median scroll depth on the elections card. Hypothesis: a more legible composition encoding shortens the time to verdict and reduces scroll past the card.

guardrails.description: Bounce rate from the elections card. Guardrail: treatment must NOT increase bounce by more than 2 percentage points.

rollback_contract.description: Removal is git revert of the (c) mount commit. The CompositionBar renderer + adapter remain in the repo as Phase 3.5 inventory but with no live mount. No URL parser change, no analytics event to clean up, no schema rollback.

review_gates.jony: Visual hierarchy on the elections card — does CompositionBar earn its keep next to SeatDonut, or does it duplicate the donut without adding clarity?
review_gates.hans: Summary-copy dominance-verb suppression — does the new bar prompt unrelated verb drift? Are vote-share + seat-share twins consistent?
review_gates.max: Single-entity scope discipline — does the treatment tempt a multi-entity comparison? If yes, escalate to Phase 0.75 guard rule.

doctrine_ties: R-08 Branch by Abstraction: SeatDonut continues to ship; CompositionBar mounts alongside, never in place of.
R-16 three-PR split: experiment definition ships in (b); mount ships in (c).
R-24 / R-28: adapter resolves Parquet path via manifest-registered table_id; no fetch telemetry.
